summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin CRUD functionality for Lord of the Rings 5e RPG app. All features verified working: Admin user 'Maestro' active by default with crown icon in header, CRUD buttons for Races/Cultures/Backgrounds/Occupations visible and functional, all editor modals open correctly, PDF download button on character sheet works. Backend API tests: 16/16 passed for all CRUD operations.
critical_code_review_comments: UserContext correctly initializes with Maestro admin user by default (no login required)
RulesPage correctly shows CRUD buttons only when isAdmin is true
All editor modals (RaceEditor, CultureEditor, BackgroundEditor, OccupationEditor) have proper data-testid attributes
Backend CRUD endpoints properly validate input and return appropriate error messages
PDF generation uses html2canvas and jsPDF libraries correctly
test_credentials: Admin user: Maestro (automatically active, no login required)
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up during CRUD tests (TEST_ prefixed items)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin CRUD functionality fully tested. All endpoints working: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE for races, cultures, backgrounds, occupations. Frontend shows admin indicator (crown + Maestro) in header. Create buttons appear in category views. Editor modals open with proper forms. PDF button on character sheet works.
